text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Proof of no criminal record * 2. Certificate of health check * 3. Scanned copy of passport (passport must be valid within 6 months from the date of submitting the application). * 4. Digital Photo 2-inch color photo, hatless, white background without border. The head occupies 2/3 of the photo size, and the photo size is no less than 320*240 Pixel, aspect ratio is 4:3, size is 100-500KB, JPG Format photo, named after passport number. * 5. Scanned copy of the highest academic transcript * 6. Scanned copy of the highest degree certificate Scanned copy of the highest academic qualification and/or degree certificate: please submit scanned copy of the graduation certificate and (or) degree certificate; If the applicant is a in-school student, he/she must submit a scanned copy of enrollment certificate issued by your school. * 7. Financial proof * 8. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
